# QUBE

> QUBE is a daily performance and recovery powder for athletes who read labels. One QUBE is mixed into water as part of a morning routine. It combines creatine monohydrate, beta-alanine, tart cherry extract, curcumin and an electrolyte blend, sweetened with monk fruit. Founded by Quinn, an NCAA D-III basketball player at Johns Hopkins.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://qubehydration.com/): the four pillars (performance, recovery, inflammation, hydration), the formula and the Founding Roster sign-up.
- [Research](https://qubehydration.com/research/): each ingredient, its dose, what the studies show, and linked sources.
- [Blog](https://qubehydration.com/blog/): plain-English posts on training, recovery and the research behind QUBE.

## Notes

- QUBE is a dietary supplement. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
- QUBE is pursuing NSF Certified for Sport and is not yet certified.
